config.name: Isolated BEPC engineering and bounded-rescue comparison

selection.QA: no decrease from nativeStrict official task score
selection.MME: total acc+accplus and overall accuracy no decrease
selection.COCO: SPICE>=.95Strict and CHAIRs<=Strict; full-description CIDEr is auxiliary and not a gate due known length floor

mat_definition.native: sum(raw accepted Draft tokens)/sum(raw verification rounds)
mat_definition.effective: sum(firstEOS/budget effective accepted Draft tokens)/sum(effective verification rounds)

quality_definition.QA: unique terminal Final answer line -> same official task evaluator; failures score0 and stay in denominator
quality_definition.COCO: full description unmodified; CIDEr-D/SPICE/CHAIR, no main label fusion
quality_definition.explanation_factual_safety: not established by QA answer accuracy

config.original_run_reuse: all completed development repeat0; no repeat1/2 in new main comparison
config.user_request: 现在先不进行重复测试，只测一遍，测完之后生成完整的实验报告
config.timing_CI_scope: image/group sampling only; no repeated-run timing variability
config.run_repeatability_scope: not assessed by one-pass main; inherited parity/development evidence separate

algorithm_changes.engineering: retire BEPC after response mismatch budget exhaustion; strict-equivalent selection
algorithm_changes.relaxation: only rescue gamma 0.5 -> 0.625; protection gamma remains 0.5
algorithm_changes.selection: single preregistered relaxation, no development/test threshold selection

noninferiority_plan.reference: concurrent strict_shared and bepc_original, reported separately
noninferiority_plan.decision: one-sided image-clustered 95% bootstrap bound must satisfy every applicable limit; otherwise not established
noninferiority_plan.adequacy: 100 test groups and historical reuse limit precision; no claim of guaranteed quality

statistical_plan.quality_scope: official final answers / automatic full-caption metrics, not human factual ground truth
statistical_plan.multiplicity: report all planned comparisons; simultaneous success requires all quality constraints; no test-based winner selection
